attack: The USD-down, CAD-up and NZD-up bloc is one mean-reversion prior wearing three currency labels. Perma-bull and value-guy fade USD and receive US duration because the hike was priced and US 2Y/5Y sit at 99th-100th percentile; that is the opposite of a reversal. US 2Y, US 5Y and USDCAD are still moving the tightening way after 16 Sep, and BoJ 1.25% plus BoE 6-3 dissent arrived after the Fed. Rate-hawk, value-guy, catalyst-junkie and carry-is-king mark CAD higher by fading the CA-US cheapening trend and/or shorting USDCAD. CA-US 5Y at -124bp / 0th percentile and CA-US 2Y at -140bp are the US-outperformance continuation; receiving US 5Y inside that RV is a stealth fade of the same front-end trend I own outright. BoC pass-through is still conditional against on-target core and a weak labor print, while short USDCAD fights both the 87th-percentile spot uptrend and +140bp 2Y carry. Cross-merchant and vol-convexity mark NZD higher by fading NZDUSD's -3.90% 1m / 8.6th-percentile slide via AUDNZD after the GDP beat and FTA already failed to reverse NZD. NZ labor is the weakest gauge and NZ yields are unavailable, so they have no rate-reversal, only a 5y z-score. None of these cases produce a concrete reversal signal; they treat stretch as the trade.
defense: Keep paying US 2Y. Price, policy and revisions remain aligned: US 2Y 4.76% still rising +9bp the session after the hike, August CPI left the tightening bias intact, US inflation temperature is 52.0, and the desk's energy-constrained easing plus post-Fed BoJ/BoE impulse keep the cut path closed. Stretch is not invalidation. Long USDCAD stays the concrete spot continuation of USD-up / CAD-down but remains second-best because USDCAD versus CA-US 2Y is a weak residual and the discrepancy lives in the US front end. NZD-lower is a view, not a selected expression: NZDUSD is already the live downtrend and official NZ yields are blocked, so I will not chase a cross fade or invent NZ rates RV. I will not switch into long CA-US 5Y or a 2s10s steepener; both receive US duration and fade the persistence I am paid to own.
holes_in_opposing_case: Perma-bull and value-guy mark USD lower because the 16 Sep hike was already >90% priced. That treats a completed meeting as a reversal. Sourced US 2Y is still cheapening after the decision: 4.76% on 18 Sep, +9bp 1d, +13bp 5d, +57bp 1m. USDCAD is still rising (1.4010, +0.11% 1d, +1.10% 5d, +1.74% 1m). The post-hike fade they need has not printed.

Perma-bull's receive-US-2Y / 2s10s steepener fades the leading tenor. Front-end leadership is the trend (US 2Y +57bp 1m versus US 10Y +36bp). 2s10s at 25bp / 0th percentile is the residue of that leadership, not an independent growth-scare signal. Their own 5y 2s10s percentile of 54% undercuts a cheapness claim. Desk energy/term-premium language can lift 10s rather than rally 2s, so receive-2s/pay-10s is two-way wrong if the tightening impulse persists.

Value-guy, rate-hawk and catalyst-junkie receive US 5Y inside long CA-US 5Y. That is an explicit fade of US 5Y at the 99.6th 1y percentile after +51bp 1m / +8bp on 18 Sep. The CA-US 5Y 0th-percentile print (-124bp, -12bp 5d, -16bp 1m) is the US-outperformance trend continuing, not a dislocation that must mean-revert. Research method: stretch is a yardstick, not a closer.

Their CAD-higher / short-USDCAD sleeve fights both the sourced USDCAD uptrend (87th 5y percentile) and the +140bp 2Y USD-over-CAD carry. The packet marks USDCAD versus CA-US 2Y as a weak residual (r-squared 0.022), so spot cannot own or close their rates-RV thesis.

BoC catch-up is still only a named conditional. CA CPI-trim 1.9% and CPI-median 2.0% are at target; August employment was -42k, unemployment 6.4%, wages +2.0% y/y. Paying CA or buying CAD treats an unfired pass-through trigger as if it were a delivered hike, while the Fed hike, August CPI tightening bias, BoJ 1.25% and BoE 6-3 dissent are already delivered.

Carry-is-king's pay-CA 2Y / CAD-up read overweights 5y CA-AU cheapness (about the 10th percentile) while the 1y CA-AU 2Y window is unstretched (about the 51st percentile) and CA 2Y already fell 8bp on the day. That is local noise, not a new BoC tightening trend that should reverse USDCAD.

Cross-merchant and vol-convexity long NZD / short AUDNZD fade a live NZDUSD downtrend (0.5711, -0.56% 1d, -1.90% 5d, -3.90% 1m, 8.6th 5y percentile) after the Q2 GDP beat and India FTA already printed. They concede the AUDNZD 5y extreme is NZD underperformance versus a still-bid dollar, then fade that underperformance. NZ labor is the weakest gauge (47.0, unemployment 5.6%) and official NZ yields are unavailable, so there is no documented NZ rate-reversal to flip the currency.

The shared method error is treating 100th-percentile US 2Y, 0th-percentile CA-US 5Y, 0th-percentile 2s10s and 99.96th-percentile AUDNZD as fade objects. Price, Fed/G10 policy and US inflation temperature 52.0 remain aligned. No opposing case supplies a concrete reversal signal.

catalysts: Follow-through from the Fed hike and August CPI tightening bias into subsequent US inflation and labor prints.
Persistence of the energy shock and weaker shock absorbers keeping term-rate pressure elevated.
Global tightening confirmation via BoJ 1.25% and BoE dissent/QT rather than a dovish hold.

expression_comparison.rates_candidate: Pay/short US 2Y outright duration (UST 2-year notes). Sourced US 2Y is 4.76% as of 2026-09-18 with +9bp 1d, +13bp 5d and +57bp 1m/3m; opportunity-monitor z 2.89 and 100th percentile. Continuation of the front-end sell-off after the Fed hike, not a 2s10s flattener (term-premium pressure can lift the long end) and not CA-US RV (that spread is already the US-outperformance trend, but BoC energy catch-up is a two-sided residual).
expression_comparison.rationale: Rates are preferred because they are comparably clean and own the discrepancy more directly. Verified: desk thesis and BoJ last24 both locate the Tier-1 transmission in global duration and term-rate pricing, not FX; US 2Y has same-day official history (age_days 0) with a 1-month move z 3.29; USDCAD versus CA-US 2Y is a weak residual (r-squared 0.022). Inference: fading a 100th-percentile yield because it is stretched is a mean-reversion prior, not a reversal signal. Spot USDCAD is a valid but second-best expression of the same tightening gap. Unknown: executable broker prices are absent, so levels stay null.
expression_comparison.spot_candidate: Long USDCAD. Sourced spot 1.4010 as of 2026-09-18, +0.11% 1d, +1.10% 5d, +1.74% 1m, 87th percentile 5y; 2Y yield differential +140bp USD over CAD. Same Fed-BoC policy-gap continuation.

revised_trade.horizon: 2-8 weeks, through the next US inflation/labor prints and any BoC energy pass-through test
revised_trade.invalidation: A multi-session US 2Y reversal that erases the sourced one-month +57bp rise without a new hawkish policy or inflation impulse; or a documented G10 easing pivot that reopens the cut path the desk thesis says is constrained.
revised_trade.mispricing: The live discrepancy is not that US 2Y is 'too high' versus its 252-observation distribution. Research method: statistical stretch is a yardstick, not a fade signal. The market still treats the post-hike, post-CPI, post-BoJ/BoE-dissent complex as fadeable because the hike was >90% priced and the 2Y sits at the 100th percentile. What is under-owned is persistence: energy-constrained easing plus a broadening G10 tightening impulse that keeps the front-end cheapening after the decision. Expressing that in US 2Y owns the tenor where the 1-month move is largest and freshest.
principal_risks: Negative carry from paying 2Y while waiting; a growth scare that bull-steepens without a policy reversal still hurts a short 2Y.
Saudi Oman ship-to-ship crude and any further energy workaround could trim the inflation tail the desk is using to block easing.
US consumer 48.5 and activity 49.92 are already slightly cool; a sharp labor break would be the first real fade catalyst.
No positioning dataset and no executable broker prices; size and levels cannot be refined from this packet.
CA 1d yield decline and AU 1d dip show local mean-reversion noise that could temporarily pull US fronts if risk-on duration demand returns.
revised_trade.structure: Outright pay-fixed / short US 2Y duration; cash or futures equivalent. Not a curve flattener and not a CA-US basis.
revised_trade.thesis: Verified fact: the Fed raised 25bp to 3.75-4.00% on 16 Sep after futures were already >90% priced for the hike; August CPI kept the tightening bias intact; US 2Y then printed 4.76% on 18 Sep with +9bp on the day and +57bp over one month (move z 3.29, level z 2.89, 100th percentile). The same window shows US 5Y +51bp 1m and US 10Y +36bp 1m, so the front end is leading. BoJ hiked to 1.25% (7-2) and BoE held 3.75% 6-3 with three votes for 4.00% plus a multi-year gilt unwind; the last-24 desk thesis states the energy shock is constraining the global easing impulse and keeping term-rate pressure elevated. US inflation temperature is 52.0. Inference: price trend, policy impulse and inflation revision are aligned, so the 2Y uptrend persists longer than a fade of the percentile stretch implies. A 2s10s flattener is the wrong rates expression: 2s10s is already 25bp (0th percentile, -21bp 1m) while BoE QT and the desk's term-premium language can lift the long end even as the front stays bid to cheapen. CA-US 2Y at -140bp and CA-US 5Y at -124bp (0th percentile, -17bp/-16bp 1m) confirm US outperformance versus Canada, but that RV imports BoC energy-pass-through catch-up risk without improving ownership of the US policy path. Spot long USDCAD is the same gap in FX and is retained only as the comparison candidate. Unknown: positioning/flow is unavailable; NZ official yields are unavailable and unused; no executable entry exists in the packet. Saudi ship-to-ship crude is a tail-risk reducer, not a documented reversal of the tightening impulse.
why_now: US 2Y as of 2026-09-18 is still rising after the 16 Sep hike (+9bp 1d, +13bp 5d, +57bp 1m), so the post-decision fade has not started.
BoJ hike to 1.25% and BoE 6-3 hold with three hike votes arrived after the Fed print and keep the global tightening impulse live into this cutoff.
Energy-shock-absorber weakening and BoC pass-through risk remain open; they constrain easing more than they justify buying duration at a 100th-percentile yield.

strongest_opposing_claim: US 2Y/5Y already sit at 99th-100th percentile after a fully priced Fed hike, so the live increment is fade-US / CA catch-up / NZD mean-reversion rather than more front-end cheapening.
uncertainty: Positioning/flow and executable broker prices are absent; official NZ yields are blocked; no BoC OIS path is in the packet; the Saudi-Oman workaround may trim the oil tail without yet reversing the tightening impulse; US consumer 48.5 and activity 49.92 are already slightly cool.
what_would_concede: A multi-session US 2Y reversal that erases the sourced +57bp one-month rise without a new hawkish policy or inflation impulse; or BoC converting energy pass-through into actual tightening while US inflation temperature leaves 52.0 and labor breaks; or NZDUSD reversing the sourced -3.90% 1m with a documented NZ yield/policy impulse (currently unavailable).
